1.script: The Sahara is the largest hot desert on Earth. Its dunes can rise higher than a fifty story building. Yet only a few thousand years ago, this land was green and full of lakes. Hippos and crocodiles lived where camels walk today. Ancient rock paintings still show the animals that once roamed here.
